# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 engine update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream rendering corrections. Linux applications that rely on fontconfig's exact fallback face should review the changed font fallback behavior before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when deterministic font selection is required.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153 and incorporates upstream Chrome m153 bug and correctness fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062))
- **Buffer uploads corrected** — Incorporates the upstream Chrome m153 fix for buffer uploads. ([#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Hardens Windows libHarfBuzzSharp builds by narrowly scoping compiler warning suppressions.
